description: Review findings for the CryptoPulse suite. Append-only by convention: entries change status, they are never deleted; IDs are never reused. Validate with: node governance/validate-ledger.mjs

findings.description: Mobile navigation stayed open when the active route was tapped: a same-hash link fires no hashchange and the close-menu callback did not re-render.
findings.verification_method: Fix 779be39: Playwright check at 390 px (menu open after tap before the fix, closed after). ChatGPT re-review of 779be39 confirmed the finding addressed.

findings.description: Persisted localStorage JSON was parsed without shape validation, so stale or unexpected valid JSON could crash rendering.
findings.verification_method: Fix 779be39: shape check with fallback; Playwright run with four malformed stored values rendered without errors. ChatGPT re-review of 779be39 confirmed the finding addressed.

findings.description: Percent-encoded traversal bypassed the raw-path guard: /ui/%2e%2e/%2egit/config returned HTTP 200 with the repository's .git/config (reproduced). Reachable from the local network with --lan.
findings.verification_method: Fix e7bbda9: decoded-path check plus containment under ui/, docs/, tasks/; ui/test_serve.py regression suite (4 encoded cases failed before the fix, all pass after). ChatGPT re-review of e7bbda9: prior traversal finding substantially addressed.

findings.description: Decoded path components were split on '/' only; on Windows a backslash is also a separator and could hide ..\.git inside one component.
findings.verification_method: Fix e887c3d: is_safe_url_path() refuses backslash and NUL; platform-independent unit tests (backslash cases fail against the previous check). Traced as not exploitable before the fix (stdlib translate_path skips separator-bearing components; containment check after resolve()). Not yet re-reviewed by ChatGPT; Windows run not performed.

findings.description: A failed review fetch was converted to an empty list, so the Review gate claimed 'No review on PR yet' and the task showed as waiting on ChatGPT although GitHub could not be queried.
findings.verification_method: Fix f29f776: loading/loaded/failed kept distinct; 3 regression tests (failed before the fix); browser run with review requests forced to fail shows Unavailable + Retry. ChatGPT re-review of f29f776: the previous finding is fixed.

findings.description: listTasks() fetches every task file with Promise.all, so one failed file fetch makes the whole task list unavailable instead of isolating that file (non-blocking resilience note).
findings.verification_method: Fix 0f951a0 (PR #12, TASK-INT-002): listTasks() uses Promise.allSettled; an unreadable task file becomes a task with loadError (ID from file name, plan gate 'error', 'Task file unavailable' pill) and the other tasks still load; only a failed directory listing fails the list. Tests: ui/tests/governance.test.mjs 'CT-0006' cases (one HTTP 500 file among three; failed listing still rejects). Author-checked only; awaiting ChatGPT independent review.

findings.description: No CI workflow runs the test suites on pull requests, so the reviewer cannot independently reproduce the Node, server, browser or phone results reported in PR descriptions (raised in every ChatGPT review of PRs #3, #6 and #7).
findings.verification_method: TASK-CI-001 (PR #9, merged as 6cc0b0d): .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on pull_request and push to main, contents: read, SHA-pinned actions, jobs Node tests / Python tests / Browser smoke reported as check runs. Evidence: run 39148370779 on PR #9 head 4ffe685 - all 3 checks success (UI unit 20/20, serve.py 6 OK, browser smoke 2/2; governance steps skipped there because governance/ was not on that ref). Run 39148831245 on PR #8 head c122c84 - all 3 success, with ledger validation "12 findings valid" and governance tests 34/34 executed in CI. Run 39148298631 (head 9d0a922) failed on a workflow YAML bug, showing failures fail the job. Checks are not yet required by branch protection (tracked as CT-0013). ChatGPT independent re-review (pullrequestreview-5564041614): VERIFIED on post-merge run 39149017727 (Node, Python, Browser smoke all success; ledger validation, governance 34/34 and UI 20/20 executed). Verification covers CI presence and passing suites, not merge enforcement (CT-0013).

findings.description: findingsState() returned PASS for accepted_risk findings, although the spec defines risk acceptance as a human override, not a technical PASS; a test locked the wrong behaviour in.
findings.verification_method: Fix 172911f: findingsGate(): high/medium accepted_risk -> FAIL with the finding listed under acceptedRisks; old test corrected; severity x status matrix test. New tests failed against 8ae4216. ChatGPT re-review of 3159284: FIX VERIFIED (accepted high/medium risk returns FAIL and is listed separately for the human override).

findings.description: A fixed but not independently verified medium finding produced PASS; only critical/high fixed findings were held at UNKNOWN.
findings.verification_method: Fix 172911f: critical/high/medium fixed -> UNKNOWN; low/info allowed but listed under unverified; full severity x status matrix test. New tests failed against 8ae4216. ChatGPT re-review of 3159284: FIX VERIFIED (critical/high/medium fixed findings return UNKNOWN; severity x status matrix covers it).

findings.description: freshnessState() returned PASS for timestamps in the future because now - ts is negative and therefore within maxAge.
findings.verification_method: History: fix 172911f returned UNKNOWN only beyond a 5-minute clock-skew allowance; ChatGPT re-review of 3159284 (pullrequestreview-5563971181) held it as PARTIALLY FIXED. Fix 3f8c834: freshnessState() returns UNKNOWN for missing, non-numeric, non-finite or any timestamp > now (no tolerance); PASS/STALE unchanged for valid past timestamps. Tests d509a01: CT-0010 acceptance matrix (+1 ms, +1 min, +1 h -> UNKNOWN; == now -> PASS; age == maxAge -> PASS, +1 ms -> STALE; undefined, null, string, numeric string, NaN, +/-Infinity, object -> UNKNOWN); fails against 172911f at +1 ms. ChatGPT independent re-review (pullrequestreview-5564041614): VERIFIED at 3f8c834 with acceptance test d509a01; passing in main CI.

findings.description: Ledger timestamps were checked for format only, so impossible dates such as 2026-99-99T99:99:99Z passed and R7 silently skipped unparseable values.
findings.verification_method: Fix 172911f: isRealUtc() round-trip check for timestamp and found_at; R7 uses only real instants; tests for 2026-99-99, 2026-02-30, T24:00, :60 and a valid leap day. New tests failed against 8ae4216. ChatGPT re-review of 3159284: FIX VERIFIED (UTC round-trip rejects impossible dates; valid leap day accepted).

findings.description: R5 rejected only the literal reviewer "Claude", so the developer could be recorded under another label and self-verify; verified entries did not require a link to the verifying review.
findings.verification_method: Fix 172911f: reviewer restricted to controlled identities (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Olivier); verified requires ChatGPT or Olivier plus a verification_url to a review on the same PR; alias and URL tests. New tests failed against 8ae4216. ChatGPT re-review of 3159284: material improvement VERIFIED with a documented limitation. Identity enum, independent-verifier rule and same-PR review URL are enforced; the label itself cannot be authenticated because all agents share one GitHub account, so it remains a human-governance control (docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md section 2).

findings.description: CI checks (Node tests, Python tests, Browser smoke) report on pull requests but are not required: no branch protection or ruleset on main enforces them, so a PR can still be merged with failing or missing checks.
findings.verification_method: Fix applied by Olivier in repository settings (no commit): ruleset 25350881, enforcement active, target default branch, no bypass actors; rules deletion, non_fast_forward and required_status_checks = Node tests, Python tests, Browser smoke (all integration 15368, GitHub Actions). First version required "Node test" (no such check): PR #10 was mergeable_state "blocked" with all three checks green on 1aeb469 (run 39150136211). After Olivier corrected it to "Node tests" (ruleset updated 2026-10-18T17:37:30Z), GET /rules/branches/main returns the three checks and PR #10 became "clean" with no new commit. Read back via the GitHub API by Claude. ChatGPT independent re-review (pullrequestreview-5564108534 on head 83c36da): VERIFIED; checked run 39150572012 (Node tests, Python tests, Browser smoke all success) and the blocked-to-clean timeline on PR #10. ChatGPT could not query the ruleset settings endpoint itself, so the exact configuration (active, default branch, no bypass, three check names) rests on Claude's API read-back in PR #10 issuecomment-6253036158.
findings.fix_reference: GitHub ruleset 25350881 "main: require CI checks" (configured by Olivier)

findings.description: Ledger validator rule R7 rejected a timestamp only if it was more than 5 minutes in the future (t > now + 5 min), contradicting docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md ('timestamp not in the future'); found_at had no future check at all.
findings.verification_method: Fix 63db4c8 (PR #10): R7 rejects any timestamp or found_at later than the validator clock, no tolerance. Tests: +1 s/+1 min/+4 min/+1 h for both fields, timestamp exactly 1 ms ahead of the clock, and timestamp === now accepted; the new test fails against the validator on main eb51bb6 (timestamp +1 s produced no error). Severity set to medium (same class as CT-0010) so it blocks until independently verified. ChatGPT independent re-review (pullrequestreview-5564108534 on head 83c36da): VERIFIED; R7 rejects timestamp > now and found_at > now with no tolerance, keeps found_at <= timestamp; regression tests reviewed; ledger validation and governance tests passed in run 39150572012.
